name: Suzumiya Haruhi no Tomadoi
source: This time Haruhi is a super-game-producer. She forces the SOS brigade to make the best game in the world. What kind of game will it be? The player takes the role of Kyon, and will have four weeks to make a game worthy of Haruhi's tastes. But beware, because if she isn't pleased, she may change reality or even close you inside a time loop...
translation: 这次，春日成了超级游戏制作人。她强迫SOS团制作出全世界最棒的游戏。最终会做成怎样的作品？玩家将扮演阿虚，在四周内制作出一款符合春日品味的游戏。但要小心：如果她不满意，可能会改变现实，甚至把你困在时间循环里……
